description: Use this after search_humanoid_database, or when the model id is known (for example unitree-g1 or figure-03), to read one record of the open humanoid robot database in full: specifications, status, source, the date the entry was reviewed and the address of the model page on merarobotics.com in every language where it exists (up to 54). No prices. When you use the data, credit "MERA Robotics, merarobotics.com" (CC BY 4.0).

lang.description: Language of the url, country name and (pl, en, zh) status label.

name: get_humanoid_model
title: Open humanoid robot database: one model
